verdict.rationale: Fellow exposes transcripts, structured notes, recordings and action items through a documented REST API with cursor pagination. Note content comes out as Fellow Markdown, which is GitHub-Flavored Markdown with extensions. Workspace-wide retrieve/export/delete is limited to Enterprise Super Admin API keys, so a regular user has to script their own export against the API rather than use a built-in export. Missing for 10: self-serve bulk export or download feature for non-Enterprise users, documented open export formats for transcripts and recordings beyond Markdown notes, a user-level account deletion or offboarding path, and independent hands-on confirmation of a complete export.
